run_finalize_qda_default: run the finalize_qda script to gather ELI5 QDA data into train, valid, and test splits using default settings
run_finalize_qda_custom_passages: run the finalize_qda script with a custom number of selected passages and context sentences per passage
run_finalize_qda_multi_subreddit: run the finalize_qda script to process multiple subreddits by passing a JSON list of subreddit names
review_main_data_splitting: review the main function that loads pre-computed split keys and assembles QDA data into train, valid, and test JSON files
refactor_main_argparse_config: refactor the main function argparse configuration to support additional CLI arguments for output directory or file format
